name: Gara (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner charged near the top with the municipal arms of Gara (a blue shield with a tree, with a helm and yellow, green and blue mantling) above the name GARA in blue.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Gara arms with helm and mantling
